$comment: The one grammar of a network-policy allowlist entry. The engine's parser (engine/crates/shared/src/network_policy.rs) and the Android builder that refuses an entry at the call site (platforms/android/library/.../NetworkPolicy.java) each read this file in a test, so the two cannot disagree about what a host may write. accepted pairs an entry with the form it is stored in; every refused entry must be refused by both. builderSample is what the Android builder writes when its test grants every channel in declaration order, alternately `<KEY>.example.com` and unrestricted, with plain HTTP and the local network on; the engine's test parses it against the same rule over its own channel list, so a channel either side has and the other lacks fails both tests.
